# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 2

This update focuses on settings reliability, updated recommended game settings and optional Samsung Xclipse driver support.

## Reliability

- More robust saving of settings after unexpected interruptions.
- Clearer messages and better access to settings and support tools when the global configuration cannot be read.
- Improved emulation scheduling reliability in certain situations. This is a general correctness improvement, not a promise of higher FPS in every game.

## Vulkan drivers

- Added the JimVulkan RADV Xclipse catalog, with global and per-game selection and dedicated optional texture settings.
- Requires Android 14 or newer and a supported Samsung Xclipse GPU. Incompatible packages and hardware are rejected without changing the previous driver selection.
- RADV support is experimental. Loading and gameplay on Xclipse hardware remain unverified; this is not a confirmed fix for FIFA rendering problems. Image quality and compatibility depend on the driver and its settings.

## Recommended settings and troubleshooting

- Updated bundled recommended game settings, including a profile for Divinity II: The Dragon Knight Saga. Improved rendering was verified in character creation; later gameplay remains unverified.
- Added an optional game startup input recorder to help reproduce launch and menu problems. It is disabled by default.

## Updating

- Update in place: no uninstall or data reset is required. Profiles, saved games and existing per-game settings are preserved.
- An already damaged configuration may still require assisted recovery; updating does not automatically rebuild it.
- Local checks used Odin 3 with system and Turnip drivers. Wider hardware and gameplay coverage remains limited.
- TV mode and synchronized player profiles remain highly experimental and may still have issues.
- X360 Companion is unchanged.
